gloss: A category defined partly by the transformations its members keep their identity under
mechanism: A {{category}} whose definition includes a list of transformations its members survive, such as paraphrase for an argument, translation for a claim or refactoring for a program. An item belongs only if it keeps the category's defining features under each listed transformation.
invariants: Lists the transformations under which members keep their identity.
An item that loses the defining features under a listed transformation is not a member.
failure_modes: Untested invariance: transformations are listed but members are never tested under them.
Over-strict list: a transformation that legitimate members fail is listed, and the category empties.

members.description: IDs of items belonging to this category

survives.description: Transformations under which members keep their identity
